products.code_info: BB 05APR24 hh:mm F6 0053 The code breaks down as: BB 05APR24: Best by Day, Month, Year hh:mm hour and minute of packaging F6 is packaging line identifier. 005: Julian Date of Manufactured Date 3: Last digit of Manufactured Year 0053: Manufactured on January 5th, 2023
